text:
IncidentBot: :rotating_light: ALERT: P99 routing latency spike detected in us-west-2 (streaming API). p99 > 3.2s for 5m, p95 creeping at 800ms. Auto-paging ENG-SRE and eng-runtime.

Morgan: seeing the page, joining bridge — link: https://meet.redwood/bridge/1758889012

Devon: I rolled a router policy change 12m ago (weighting tweak for shard affinity). rolling_commit=abc123 -> might be related.

Kira: loading heatmap now, very obvious hotshard around shard_id=9876, KV cache misses spike coincident with commit timestamp. attaching short snippet from flame: `router::dispatch -> hot_shard_lookup (avg 1.8ms -> 120ms)`

Samir: suggests immediate mitigation: divert traffic off hot shard by adjusting balancer weights for shard 9876 to 0.2 for 10m and enable eager-fallback. command: `redwoodctl route adjust-weight --shard 9876 --weight 0.2 --reason "hotshard mitigation"`

Leo: customer impact check: top 3 accounts with elevated tail latency: acme-inc (+20% errors), travelio (+14%), mediahub (+9%). Support notified.

oncall-sre: executing weight adjustment now. will post status when done.

IncidentBot: ACTION: weight adjust job queued (job_id=job-77f). expected propagation ~45s.

Devon: if weight adjust doesn't help, rollback the last policy rollout to the previous seed (commit def456). rollback plan: `deploy router-policy --target def456 --strategy immediate` (from runbook: routing-regressions -> rollback-fast).

Kira: after weight adjust, p99 dropped to 1.9s at t+90s, p95 back to ~500ms. tail stalls still visible in streaming cold paths but much improved.

Samir: run a lightweight KV warmup on the affected shard to repopulate prefix cache: `redwoodctl runtime kv-warmup --shard 9876 --duration 60s --concurrency 5`

Leo: continuing to monitor customer impact dashboards, support escalation updated: pagerduty incident open PD-8932.

Devon: flagged a bug in router policy evaluation that misapplies affinity rules when shard weights are near-zero after fast rollouts — filing ticket: RDW-1298.

oncall-sre: finished warmup job. streaming tail stalls reduced; live logs show prefix cache hitrate +15%.

Morgan: great mitigation. plan: keep adjusted weight for 15m, observe for 30m, then either reintroduce with controlled rollout or rollback policy permanently, depending on RDW-1298 fix.

IncidentBot: INCIDENT UPDATE: p99 now 820ms (5m avg), p95 470ms. Customer-facing SLOs still met for majority, but we will stay on bridge for monitoring.

Kira: capturing traces for postmortem. please add any CLI outputs or timestamps to the incident timeline in the ticket.

Samir: if RDW-1298 is root cause, we should add a canary gate in policy rollout to check hotshard skew before full rollout.

Morgan: agreed — action items: 1) RDW-1298 ticket, 2) short-term rollout gating, 3) runbook updates for fast-weight-adjust mitigation.

Leo: closing the customer escalation for now, keeping PD incident open until metrics stable for 60min. :thumbsup:

IncidentBot: BRIDGE CLOSED (auto) — time elapsed 00:42: late notes archived to RDW-1298 and incident-1758889012 timeline.
